title: Shipping Policy
content: Orders are shipped within 2-5 business days within Egypt. Cash on delivery is the only available payment method.

title: Return Policy
content: Products can be returned or exchanged within 14 days from the delivery date, provided that the product is in its original condition.

title: Privacy Policy
content: We respect our customers' privacy and do not share their personal data with any third party except when required for shipping purposes.

title: Terms and Conditions
content: By using this website, you agree to our purchasing and cash-on-delivery terms and agree to comply with our return policy.

title: About Us
content: A youth clothing store offering men's and women's fashion for customers aged 18 to 35. We started as a Facebook page and are proud to serve our customers with the best quality and prices.
